reviews.reason: This fixture exports three deliberately separate scene entry points: notification settings, notification logs and notification inbox. The style registry consumes them independently; their React state is not shared merely by module colocation. NotificationSceneEventSource moved unchanged into notifications/data.ts and the inbox effect still owns observer cleanup and restoration of the prior EventSource constructor. The count diagnostic is not evidence of a production component ownership conflict. Reassessed 2026-10-29: The fixture delta follows communications endpoints, adds structured log extra/detail and delegates command-binding responses; scene mounting and React component boundary contracts remain unchanged.
